products.body_html:
Staying true to our 360º approach to hair wellness, we’ve created the only plant-based dry shampoo with Vegamour's follicle-stimulating technology.

This scalp balancing, volumizing formula fuses the texturizing perks of a traditional dry shampoo with the upshot of the same powerful phyto-actives found in our best-selling GRO Hair Serum, clinically tested to help increase visible hair density and inhibit the production of follicle damaging DHT.

Best used in tandem with our GRO or GRO+ hair serums for additional support on those days when you don’t wash your hair, this talc-free, lightweight formula utilizes an eco-friendly propellant for even, effective distribution and is free of synthetic fragrances.

Now you can GRO on the go!

  • Safe for everyday use, with no known toxins or hormones
  • 100% vegan, clean and cruelty-free
  • Features the same fresh bergamot scent found in our serums
  • Uses organic rice starch to absorb oil and impurities
  • Satisfaction guaranteed. View our Return Policy.
